Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Introduced a flawed verification method and a coding error. The check_operating_hours function assumed perform_web_search would return an iterable (causing a TypeError on None) and relied on finding the exact string “11:00 PM” in a single search snippet to confirm hours. This brittle approach misses valid results (different formats like “11 pm”/“12 am”, different sources) and led to false negatives and the erroneous conclusion that no nearby eateries are open at 11 PM on Wednesdays.
